name: p34_acquisition_f1
title: Biohub P34 Acquisition F1
diagnostic_reason: PKT-0030 acquisition. The fold-1 mirror of the P30 fold-0 export: pre-ILP candidate graph plus richer candidate-probability sidecars on top of the P28 fold-1 champion control. No treatment variable is set, the consumed graph is unchanged, and no submission is produced.
purpose: REMOVES THE CROSS-FITTING BLOCKER NAMED BY FACT-0381. A parent ranker cannot be cross-fitted today because fold 1 has no richer candidate export: FACT-0369's deployed rule softmaxes over the SOURCE axis and thresholds at 0.5, so at most one parent per target survives, and a top-1 accuracy measured on that surface is 1.0 by arithmetic for ANY model. A metric that cannot fail is not evidence, so this run manufactures the fold-1 surface on which a held-out ranker claim can actually be made. It is the exact fold-1 mirror of the P30 fold-0 acquisition (FACT-0373 audits A-D all passed there), on the P28 fold-1 champion control base with split-1 weights. TREATMENT IS DISABLED: BIOHUB_EDGE_CANDIDATE_THRESHOLD and BIOHUB_EDGE_CANDIDATE_TOPK are deliberately UNSET, so the consumed candidate list, the emitted graph and every downstream stage stay bit-identical to the P28 fold-1 control (EXP-0031) - the acquisition must not change the thing it observes. WHY THE PRE-ILP EXPORT IS INCLUDED ALONGSIDE THE SIDECARS even though only the richer candidates are wanted: the sidecar records idx_src/idx_tgt as positional indices into coords_so_far, while the graph addresses nodes through the ids bulk_add_nodes returns. Audit check D proves those coincide, and it can only be run self-consistently if BOTH artifacts come from the SAME run. Joining new sidecars to the 2026-08-19 preilp_f1_v2 parquet from a different run would ASSUME the very node-id stability the audit exists to prove. Cross-run stability against that older parquet is then measured as a separate, additional check rather than assumed. No submission.
